title: Disunite
summary: DISUNITE, verb transitive disyunite. [dis and unite.] To separate; to disjoin; to part; as, to disunite two allied countries; to disunite particles of matter; to disunite friends. DISUNITE, verb intra

inlines.v: DISUNITE, verb transitive disyunite. [dis and unite.] To separate; to disjoin; to part; as, to disunite two allied countries; to disunite particles of matter; to disunite friends. DISUNITE, verb intransitive To part; To fall asunder; to become separate. Particles of matter may spontaneously disunite
